tasks.label: kill-node-and-clean-branch
tasks.command: cd /d "C:\Users\Aryan Ruthwik\OneDrive\Documents\MyFamDoctor" && taskkill /F /IM node.exe /T >nul 2>&1 & if exist "frontend\node_modules" rmdir /s /q "frontend\node_modules" & if exist "backend\target" rmdir /s /q "backend\target" & if exist ".vscode" rmdir /s /q ".vscode" & git add -A & git status --short --branch & echo --- & git commit -m "Remove generated artifacts" & git push --force origin clean-main:main & git status --short --branch

tasks.label: verify-clean-repo-state
tasks.command: cd /d "C:\Users\Aryan Ruthwik\OneDrive\Documents\MyFamDoctor" && git status --short --branch && echo --- && git ls-files | findstr /I "node_modules target .vscode"

tasks.label: commit-cleanup-deletions
tasks.command: cd /d "C:\Users\Aryan Ruthwik\OneDrive\Documents\MyFamDoctor" && git add -A && git status --short --branch && echo --- && git commit -m "Remove generated artifacts" && git status --short --branch
